Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team loved the latency profile and the cost controls. We're ready to move forward with a 4-week POC but need a short, concrete mutual action plan (MAP) that spells out: 1) the success criteria NovaWell will use to accept the POC, 2) the exit gates if thresholds aren't met, and 3) the acceptance tests (smoke/regression) we can run.

Target kickoff: Dec 7. Our internal stakeholders are me and Alicia (cc'd). Security review is light but will want to see simplest evidence of data handling and audit logs. Can you send a one-page MAP + acceptance checklist by Monday?

Thanks —
Chris

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & success criteria for POC

Chris / Alicia —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-draft MAP (MAP-NovaWell-v1.docx) and a suggested smoke-test spreadsheet (evaluation-smoke-tests.xlsx). Key highlights:

- Success criteria (pass = all must be met):
  * Avg tail-latency (p99) for 512-token requests <= 220ms under defined traffic profile;
  * Mean generation quality — top-2 accuracy on our seed prompt set >= 92% (sampled eval);
  * Token cost per 1k generations <= $X (redacted in draft, will itemize in follow-up).
- Exit gates:
  * If p99 > 400ms for two consecutive full-day runs OR quality < 85% after two remediation cycles -> pause trial and run root-cause review.
- Acceptance tests included in the spreadsheet: smoke (connectivity + inference sanity), throughput soak (8 hours @ target QPS), and regression spot-checks (50 seeded prompts).

Timeline proposal:
- Nov 23: agree MAP and test owners (this week)
- Dec 7: POC kickoff (customer infra + model pin)
- Dec 8–11: smoke + baseline runs (daily sync)
- Dec 12–19: full soak + targeted regression runs
- Dec 20: joint review + sign (go/no-go)

Next steps I need from NovaWell by EOD Monday: confirmation of the seeded prompt set owner, target QPS for the soak, and primary success owner for go/no-go. I'll loop in Solutions (Karthik) for security/compliance items once you confirm.

Attachments: MAP-NovaWell-v1.docx (draft), evaluation-smoke-tests.xlsx

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
